_about: THE mute / remind-less state lines (round f31; the user, 2026-10-22: 'muted alerts should show a countdown, and the
Never option makes no sense … figure out the best copywriting'). Android alerts/MuteCopy.kt (en + es, MuteCopyTest)
and Mac MuteCopy (en, -alerts-selftest) build every line from these cases. Wording after AOSP Do Not Disturb
(core/res zen_mode_forever 'Until you turn off' / 'Hasta que lo desactives', zen_mode_until 'Until %1$s',
zen_mode_duration_hours 'For 1 hour' / 'Durante 1 hora'). Durations through Durations.text (lines) and
Durations.compact (the card pill). 'side' = the side's alerts: low (very low too), high (very high, extremely high
too), falling_fast, rising_fast, no_data. es side names: de glucosa baja, de glucosa alta, de bajada rápida, de
